The '''Galactic City SpeedPipe''' was a busy [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the years following the [[Swarm War]]. Built underneath the cityspace and cutting across [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] diagonally, access to the Pipe was restricted to private [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] whose owners paid a 100-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] toll for use of the tunnel. However, use of the Pipe could cut an hour-long journey through Galactic City down to a fifteen-minute trip. The high toll fee kept traffic through the Pipe to a minimum.

During the [[Skirmish on Coruscant (Second Galactic Civil War)|Skirmish on Coruscant]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] used the Pipe in order to evade pursuit by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]; however, Solo pursued Veila through the Pipe illegally.
